payload.title: [native-swift-7] flushPending re-decodes every queued frame on the hot path solely for a telemetry label
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING native-swift-7 (low/stability, confidence=medium, verify-votes +2/-0)

FILE: packages/swift/Sources/FrickSwift/FrickSyncSocket.swift
LINES: 1204-1222

WHAT: `flushPending` now calls `FrickMsgPackCodec.decodeFrame(entry.frame)` for each drained frame just to recover `kind` for the telemetry counter. This fully re-parses every buffered frame (including potentially large append payloads) on every reconnect flush. It is also the one decode site here that can hit the `intValue` NaN trap (finding native-swift-3) on locally re-encoded data, though local frames are trusted. Primarily a performance/robustness regression on reconnect with a large pending buffer.

IMPACT: Redundant CPU on reconnect proportional to queued-frame size; minor. No correctness impact for well-formed local frames.

SUGGESTED FIX: Store the `FrickFrameKind` alongside the encoded bytes in `PendingSocketAppend` at enqueue time instead of re-decoding on flush.
